features.name: spectral_contrast

features.definition: SC_j = \ln \frac{\frac{1}{a_j} \sum_{i=1}^{a_j} x_{j,(|B_j|-i+1)}}{\frac{1}{a_j} \sum_{i=1}^{a_j} x_{j,(i)}}, \quad a_j = \max(1, \lfloor \alpha |B_j| + \tfrac{1}{2} \rfloor), \quad B_0 = \{k : f_k < e\}, \; B_j = \{k : 2^{j-1} e \le f_k < 2^j e\}, \; B_K = \{k : f_k \ge 2^{K-1} e\}, \quad x_{j,(i)} \text{ the coefficients of } B_j \text{ in ascending order}, \; j = 0, \dots, K

features.name: cqt
features.title: Constant-Q Transform
features.description: Extract the constant-Q spectrum of a complex spectrum
features.definition: X_b = \left| \sum_{j=0}^{N/2-1} X_j \, \overline{K_{bj}} \right|, \quad K_{bj} = \frac{\sum_{n=0}^{L_b-1} w_b(n) \, e^{2 \pi i f_b n / f_s} e^{-2 \pi i j (n + s_b) / N}}{\sum_{n=0}^{L_b-1} w_b(n)}, \quad w_b(n) = \tfrac{1}{2} - \tfrac{1}{2} \cos \frac{2 \pi n}{L_b - 1}, \quad L_b = \mathrm{round}\left(\frac{Q f_s}{f_b}\right), \; s_b = \left\lfloor \frac{N - L_b}{2} \right\rfloor, \; Q = \frac{1}{2^{1/B} - 1}, \; f_b = f_{\min} 2^{b/B}, \; K_{bj} = 0 \text{ where } |K_{bj}| < \theta \max_j |K_{bj}|

features.name: covariance_matrix
features.title: Covariance Matrix
features.description: Extract the covariance matrix of a set of series
features.definition: S_{ij} = \frac{1}{M-1} \sum_{n=0}^{M-1} (x^{(i)}_n - \bar{x}^{(i)})(x^{(j)}_n - \bar{x}^{(j)}), \quad i, j = 0, \dots, C-1, \quad M = N/C, \quad x^{(i)}_n = d_{iM+n}, \quad C \text{ the number of series given in argv}

features.name: correlation_matrix
features.title: Correlation Matrix
features.description: Extract the correlation matrix of a set of series from their covariance matrix
features.definition: R_{ij} = \frac{S_{ij}}{\sqrt{S_{ii}} \sqrt{S_{jj}}} \text{ limited to } [-1, 1] \text{ for } i \ne j, \; R_{ii} = 1, \quad S_{ij} = S_{ji} = d_{iC+j} \text{ for } i \le j \text{ (the upper triangle)}, \quad C = \sqrt{N}; \text{ no result when some } S_{ii} \le 0

features.name: average_correlation
features.title: Average Correlation
features.description: Extract the average correlation of a set of series from their correlation matrix
features.definition: \bar{r} = \frac{1}{C(C-1)} \sum_{i=0}^{C-1} \sum_{j \ne i} R_{ij}, \quad C = \sqrt{N} \ge 2

features.name: principal_variances
features.title: Principal Variances
features.description: Extract the variances of the principal components of a set of series from their covariance matrix
features.definition: \lambda_0 \ge \lambda_1 \ge \dots \ge \lambda_{C-1}, \quad \det(S - \lambda I) = 0, \quad S_{ij} = S_{ji} = d_{iC+j} \text{ for } i \le j, \quad C = \sqrt{N}

features.name: packed
features.title: Packed Spectrum
features.description: Extract the elements of a spectrum that have an amplitude other than 0
features.definition: r_k = a_{n_k}, \; r_{M+k} = f_{n_k} \text{ for the } K \text{ indices } n_0 < \ldots < n_{K-1} \text{ with } a_n \ne 0; \; r_k = r_{M+k} = 0 \text{ for } k \ge K, \quad a_n = x_n, \; f_n = x_{M+n}, \; M = N/2

features.name: magnitude_spectrum
features.title: Magnitude Spectrum
features.description: Extract the magnitude spectrum from a complex spectrum
features.definition: r_m = \sqrt{a_m^2 + b_m^2}, \quad r_{M+m} = m \Delta f, \quad a_m = x_m, \; b_m = x_{M+m}, \quad m = 0, \ldots, M-1, \quad M = N/2, \quad \Delta f \text{ the bin spacing given in argv}

features.name: power_spectrum
features.title: Power Spectrum
features.description: Extract the power spectrum from a complex spectrum
features.definition: r_m = a_m^2 + b_m^2, \quad r_{M+m} = m \Delta f, \quad a_m = x_m, \; b_m = x_{M+m}, \quad m = 0, \ldots, M-1, \quad M = N/2, \quad \Delta f \text{ the bin spacing given in argv}

features.name: log_spectrum
features.title: Log Spectrum
features.description: Extract the log spectrum from a complex spectrum
features.definition: r_m = 1 + \frac{\ln P_m}{-\ln \epsilon^2} \text{ if } P_m > \epsilon^2, \text{ else } 0, \quad P_m = a_m^2 + b_m^2, \quad r_{M+m} = m \Delta f, \quad a_m = x_m, \; b_m = x_{M+m}, \quad M = N/2, \quad \epsilon = 2^{-52}

features.name: phase_spectrum
features.title: Phase Spectrum
features.description: Extract the phase spectrum from a complex spectrum
features.definition: r_m = \operatorname{atan2}(b_m, a_m) \in [-\pi, \pi], \; \operatorname{atan2}(0, 0) = 0, \quad r_{M+m} = m \Delta f, \quad a_m = x_m, \; b_m = x_{M+m}, \quad M = N/2
